PRIV-1.title: Private Word files are in the public Word-to-Table repo
PRIV-1.lead: R5.docx and 'R5 -Table15.docx' are tracked in the public repo since 9 Oct, and S1.2/S1.3 tests quote Native Word.docx text. Rights and publication are yours.

options.label: Make the repo private (suggested)
options.body: You switch Word-to-Table to private in GitHub Settings (OTM may not change settings). Nothing is public from then on; later scrubbing can follow calmly.

options.label: Scrub, then rewrite history
options.body: Remove the files and literals, then rewrite or delete public branches and history; force pushes are your call.

options.label: Leave as is
options.body: The files stay public; recorded as your override in CL #1.

answer.text: C: leave public (Owner 25 Oct 06:06). No visibility change, no scrub; no new private bytes go to public GitHub.

O3-RB.title: Confirm Oracle 3's intent read-back
O3-RB.lead: O3 read back the Doc to Table intent (Word-to-Table#1 6392206866). Your one confirmation lets OTM cut over: O2 retires, O3 runs at epoch 3 and adopts G2.1's SCTL-P1.1. No IR on this project, so your word is the gate.

options.label: Confirm (suggested)
options.body: The read-back matches your intent; OTM records the cutover and routes O3's D1 check.

options.label: Correct it
options.body: Say what is wrong; OTM passes it to O3, and the cutover waits.

PR7-MERGE.title: Merge PR #7 after a non-author PASS?
PR7-MERGE.lead: O3 asks: after a fresh non-author check passes at PR #7's exact head with green CI, may OTM merge the fourth tab into main while Microsoft Word page parity stays NOT_VERIFIED (the tab says so)? A merge is not acceptance.

options.label: Yes, scoped merge (suggested)
options.body: Merge only after a non-author PASS and green CI at the exact head; the NOT_VERIFIED label stays in the UI; no Word-fidelity claim.
options.reply: A: yes, scoped merge of PR #7 after non-author PASS

options.label: Ask me again then
options.body: OTM brings the PASS to you before any merge.
options.reply: B: ask me before merging PR #7
